scope: Independent source and existing generated-receipt review; no helper/test rerun, actual data, checkpoint, inference, training or metric execution.
correctness_findings: Replay uses a detached clone of the pre-forward incoming state under current post-update weights, preventing double processing of the current chunk.
Successful control and treatment replay symmetrically; explicit skip performs no replay. No optimizer, scaler, scheduler, loss or EMA objects enter helper.

CPU/requested-CUDA RNG is isolated; deterministic fixed-buffer forward is required. Buffer object registry mutations and value mutations are rejected and restored; unchanged buffer version counters remain unchanged.
Original trainer scheduler and EMA calls after scaler.step/update are correctly retained even on skipped student steps.
Full-prefix reference uses identical chunk boundaries; temporary probe outputs/states never enter continuing training trajectory.
One future counted pilot is bounded at 256 attempts, 480 seconds and 16 fixed probes. Skipped/incomplete/nonfinite probes cannot be replaced to obtain a pass.

interpretation_caveats.issue: Four first-chunk probes are structurally easier.
interpretation_caveats.impact: At these reset boundaries the saved incoming state is None, so local replay and full-prefix reconstruction coincide algebraically under identical kernels. Twelve successes can contain these four plus eight of twelve noninitial probes.
interpretation_caveats.required_reporting: Report all sixteen values and distinguish the four reset-boundary cases; do not portray twelve successes as twelve independent long-history corrections. No retrospective gate change.

interpretation_caveats: Generated evidence covers CPU toy GRU only, not actual GRU CUDA/AMP/fused optimizer success detection. Correct CUDA device list must be supplied to guard device RNG.

Generated test creates an optimizer state snapshot but directly compares step counters, parameters and gradients; it does not independently compare every optimizer moment. The helper itself has no optimizer reference.
The guard is not a general transaction: parameter writes, buffer metadata/shape changes, dynamic modules and external hooks remain explicitly unsupported.
Early, restricted, class-stratified train-only discrepancy is not forecast efficacy or evidence about late training.
No full adapter, operational resource controller, actual-wrapper parity or CUDA overflow proof exists yet. Those remain required before a separate root allocation.
allocation_decision: No empirical allocation implied. Preserve proposal as future preparation only.
